content.text:
I fixed the CRLF problem in `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` (`packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownUtils.ts`).

**Cause:** When a page wraps its imports (such as `import TabItem from '@theme/TabItem'`) in an ` ```mdx-code-block ` fence, Docusaurus removes the fence before compiling the page. The patterns that find these fences only accepted `\n` line endings. In a Windows (CRLF) file every line ends in `\r\n`, so the fence was never found and stayed in place. The imports then rendered as a code block instead of running, and MDX failed with "Expected component `TabItem` to be defined". This is my best reading of the issue: the screenshot wasn't available, so I'm inferring that the user's file uses this fence.

**Fix:** The 3- and 4-backtick fence patterns now accept either `\n` or `\r\n` (`\r?\n`) wherever they previously expected `\n`.

**Check:** I ran a temporary test that unwraps a CRLF `mdx-code-block` holding a Tabs import. It passed, as did the existing `markdownUtils` tests (93 in total). I deleted the temporary test afterwards, so the repo has no new test for this.

I also checked the admonition-title preprocessor in the same file, and it already copes with CRLF.
